item.title: Broken, not dead: Dios #9476 the Twice-Born (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)).
item.description: Broken, not dead: Dios #9476 the Twice-Born (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Dios #9476 the Twice-Born ros
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Dios #9476 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.
